answer: In PoA, each agent identity is bound to a Wesolowski VDF requiring a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, where every result gates the next and a compact proof enables efficient verification. Cloning identities provides no proportional speedup: GPUs can verify proofs in parallel, but cannot parallelize the dependency chain, imposing a strict physical time bottleneck on Sybil creation. Even a fable about a cipher on an island cannot evade this constraint.
